notes.title: Natural Disaster Update
notes.notes:
For those who want an additional challenge: turn up the new natural disaster slider (under Free Game > Simulation) and show your people what a powerful god you truly are! Fight wildfires, flood volcanoes or rebuild dykes after an earthquake: these dozen different disasters will certainly keep you busy.

Edit: In Town Planner mode you can now also spawn natural disasters yourself.

notes.title: Update: Chaos mode added!
notes.notes:
Changelog of the latest update:

- Added the chaos mode to Free Games: you can now activate the chaos mode (the button is under the score) to spice things up a bit! Below you'll find a detailed description of what changes this causes. Generally you'll experience more features (factories, wars, pollution, fires,...) in a shorter period of time / independant from society stats and all that complicated stuff.

- The tile chisel brush is now available from the get-go in Free Games (previously it had to be unlocked in the Story mode). Just head over to the settings tab under the Free Game menu and click the checkbox.

- For those who experience motion sickness: you can now lock the camera by pressing 'c' and move the brush around freely.

P.S. I may be overworked a little bit, so if I screwed something up: you can report all bugs in the Steam discussion boards or the Discord:
https://discordapp.com/invite/SvNW8bx


*** Chaos Mode Description ***

In chaos mode every region has a chaos need (shown on the map under "Show Homes") which needs to be satisfied. If you don't manage to satisfy that need, well...

- Pleasure: If you can't light the fire in their heart, they're gonna light a fire in the woods...
- Hygiene: If you don't give them soap, they forget all about hygiene and start dumping their trash everywhere...
- Fun: If they can't have fun seeing other people fall over, they'll find new fun in making trees fall over...
- Thirst: If you can't provide them with enough healthy water, they'll start drinking alcohol... losing all moral standards... and becoming criminals...
- Shelter: If they no longer have that soothing safety that date mortar provides, they get all panicky, stumble all the time and create potholes everywhere...

Additionally:
Factories are built in certain locations, independant from society stats, as long as there's enough fence wood.
Wars will break out easier, if one ethnicity has a higher need satisfaction that's making the other one jealous.

And finally there's chaos gambling:
If you collect fruits and bring them to a building, some crafted items can magically appear and be distributed among your people! Or... something else might happen...

notes.title: Release Date and new Trailer
notes.notes:
Tidal Tribe got a new trailer and finally has a release date! It will be available on July 18, 2019 (with a 10% launch discount). So if you feel like building some sandcastles at the beach but don't wanna go out into that hot, burning sun: I've got you covered!

Oh, and there's now also a Discord server that you can join if you wanna stay up to date, get future beta access, etc. Apparently that's where all the hip people hang out nowadays. (I start feeling old...)
https://discord.gg/SvNW8bx
